name: structural-scanner-anchor-relocation
body: The bundled structural scanner is the `structfrontend` binary built from `src/structlib`. The durable anchors are: `solution.container.structural-scanner` implemented-by the Module `rust.structfrontend`; `solution.component.structural-scanner-crate` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.structfrontend.main`, and `rust.structfrontend.run`; and `solution.component.structural-format-emitters` implemented-by `rust.structfrontend.discovery.walk`, `rust.structfrontend.lines.line_count`, `rust.structfrontend.md.parse_headings`, and `rust.structfrontend.md.build_doc`.
